description: Export as a Photoshop file (File > Export > Export As > Photoshop): colour model, resolution, layers, editable text, maximum editability, anti-aliasing, ICC profile, one file per artboard

artboards.description: Artboards to export, 1-based like Illustrator: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

colorModel.description: rgb, cmyk or grayscale. Default the document's colour mode

editableText.description: Keep text editable where possible. Default true

embedIccProfile.description: Embed the colour profile. Default false

maximumEditability.description: Write each top-level sublayer as a layer to keep as much editable as possible. Default true

resolution.description: Pixels per inch: 72 screen, 150 medium, 300 high. Default 150

useArtboards.description: One file per artboard (Illustrator adds the artboard name). False exports all artwork as one image. Default true

writeLayers.description: Keep layers as Photoshop layers instead of flattening. Default true

name: export_psd
title: Export Psd
